description: United Kingdom work permit / work visa from Pakistan: requirements, documents, fees, timeline, mistakes and FAQ. SK Immigration Services Honest guidance by SK Immigration Services, Rawalpindi.

faqs.question: How to get UK Skilled Worker visa from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: A licensed UK sponsor issues a CoS; you apply on GOV.UK with English, TB and identity documents. SK prepares the file; UKVI decides.

faqs.question: Can SK find me a UK sponsor?
faqs.answer: We help with CV packaging and realistic guidance. Sponsorship must come from a real licensed employer — we do not sell fake CoS.

faqs.question: Do I need IELTS for UK work?
faqs.answer: Usually an approved English test at the level required by the visa route (unless exempt).

faqs.question: Graduate route vs Skilled Worker?
faqs.answer: Graduate Route is for eligible UK graduates. Skilled Worker needs sponsorship. Different paths.

body:
United Kingdom work permit / work visa from Pakistan

The UK is highly regulated: only Home Office licensed sponsors can issue CoS. We never invent sponsorships.

Requirements

  • Certificate of Sponsorship from a licensed UK sponsor
  • Job meeting skill and salary thresholds for the route
  • English language at required CEFR level
  • TB test for Pakistan residents when required
  • Passport, TB certificate, and online UKVI application

Process

  1. Verify sponsor licence / CoS authenticity
  2. Document and English plan
  3. Online application coaching
  4. Biometrics appointment prep
  5. Decision tracking and travel briefing

Documents

  • Passport and CoS details
  • English test results
  • TB certificate
  • Degree / professional docs if claimed on CoS
  • Financial evidence if required by the route

Related checklist tool: Open checklist →

Fees

SK from PKR 80,000. UKVI fees, IHS and TB costs are separate and often substantial.

Timeline

Often several weeks to a few months after CoS issuance, depending on UKVI processing.

Common mistakes

  • Fake CoS / unlicensed “sponsors”
  • Wrong English test type
  • Underestimating Immigration Health Surcharge costs
  • Incomplete work history explanations

Work route reality check for United Kingdom

Skilled Worker and related routes need licensed sponsorship — not visit-visa shortcuts.

SK Immigration helps with CV packaging, document checklists and appointment prep. We do not sell fake job guarantees. Employers and missions decide.

Before you pay anyone

  • Confirm the job/contract type matches the visa subclass
  • Language level matches employer expectations
  • Educational documents follow the correct attestation chain
  • You understand SK fees vs medical/government fees
